back: The release of electrons from a heated metal surface.
Heated cathode emits electrons; positive anode accelerates them; a hole in the anode forms a beam; all in a vacuum.

front: Why is a cathode-ray tube evacuated?
back: So electrons do not collide with gas molecules.
It bends towards the positive plate.

front: Electron beam in a magnetic field?
back: Deflected at right angles: left-hand rule with the current opposite to the electrons' motion.
